title: %z datetime regex adds uncounted capture groups, shifting later fields' values
property: fields following a {:%...%z} field are parsed to their own text
actual: r[1] == '00' (or the call crashes with a TypeError for some formats), because the %z regex contains 2 capturing groups that Parser._handle_field does not count in _group_index
evidence: Every other multi-group type increments _group_index for its internal groups; the datetime branch does not, so positional fixed-field indices become wrong. The %z pattern should use non-capturing groups (?:...).
